svg.title: How the light is made
svg.desc: An editorial process diagram for fictional ceramic lighting brand Kilnform. Four stages read left to right: Shape, Dry, Fire, Finish. Drawn symbols are schematic; process wording is general and requires production review.

g.aria-label: Four deliberate stages, from raw clay to a warm glow.

text.tspan: Four deliberate stages, from raw clay to a warm glow.

g.aria-label: Shape: Hands shape the clay into a calm, balanced form.
Hands shape the clay into a calm, balanced form.

text.tspan: Hands shape the clay into a

g.aria-label: Dry: Air leaves the body slowly before it enters the kiln.
Air leaves the body slowly before it enters the kiln.
Fire: Heat hardens the body and sets its final surface.
Heat hardens the body and sets its final surface.
Finish: Glaze, wiring and testing turn the form into light.
Glaze, wiring and testing turn the form into light.
